Author: koko
Name: Housing Studio
Punchline: Furnish your house from a Housing Studio build or a MakePlace layout.
Description:
Place a Housing Studio build or a MakePlace layout in your home: every piece is matched to what you have, moved or placed at its exact spot, and dyed to match. It can also fetch what's missing, save your home as a build, and send shots of it to its page on the site.

Open it with /hstudio in a home you're allowed to decorate.
